history.overview: The Final Altar is the Ocean God’s shattered domain, where divine water rites collapsed under Discord corruption.

timeline.name: Altar Constructed
timeline.description: Built as the Ocean God’s most sacred site.

timeline.name: Divine Rites Performed
timeline.description: High priests conducted powerful oceanic planar rites.

timeline.name: Discord Rupture
timeline.description: Discord energy shattered the altar and destabilized planar water flows.

timeline.name: Catastrophic Collapse
timeline.description: The altar became a vortex of divine and Discord instability.
